scope: Ten public unscored Year 2 English Topic Guides AC9E2LA01–LA10. This is not a blind scored-bank solve, human teacher approval or linked-product certification.

selection.source: Read all 440 authored scalar fields (430 teaching strings plus 10 code IDs), all 51 retained sections, 33 actual stimulus packets and all 17 declared retained corrections, including the final SVG exception. Recomputed grammar/reference/relationship tasks and checked alternatives, complete givens, actual cultural sources and performance boundaries.
selection.risk_basis: Emphasis on cultural protocol permissions/local meanings, source-dependent appreciation, reference ambiguity/omission, actual print/screen navigation, independent clauses/coordinator meaning, full noun/verb groups, real visual evidence versus inference, unsupported vocabulary changes and declared title/list styles. Every code, three entry focuses and Starter/Core/Stretch supports were included.
selection.render: All 30 native and 10 inline model PNGs were individually opened from actual hosted files. After the arrow repair, the replacement LA04 PNG was opened again. All final 100 PNGs, including 60 viewport images, were independently hashed; root separately inspected all 60 viewport frames. The changed LA08 phone lesson frame was also independently opened.

findings.finding: Two repeated vocabulary model packets added gardener and walked without draft evidence while framing the changes as a clearer edit.
findings.repair: Both packets explicitly announce a new fictional version, explain the added occupation/action details and distinguish it from a fact-preserving edit.
findings.recheck: PASS: both exact current sections inspected; all associated text/tasks and boundary guidance checked. No visual/model change was needed.

findings.finding: Earlier back-reference arrowhead faced right while the line from They to The chicks ran left.
findings.repair: Only one SVG d attribute changed from M203 60H158m-7-5l7 5-7 5 to M203 60H158m7-5l-7 5 7 5.
findings.recheck: PASS: independent whole-file identity proof plus actual final hosted replacement PNG shows a left-pointing arrow from They toward The chicks. All other labels/geometry are preserved.

source_checks.preservation: Exact SEO metadata, canonicals, JSON-LD, original useful teaching and same-code resources checked by source comparison. All ten earlier SVGs preserved except the independently verified single arrow-path repair; native figure and image inventories match.
source_checks.actual_remote_identity: Independently fetched all ten actual raw pages at b68be77e75873f884c00b0e4276c412b137ae779 through the GitHub connector and proved each UTF-8 byte string equals the exact current reviewed local file.
source_checks.navigation: LA05 contains three real native menu/link models with unique references and actual section destinations; print contents/index terms resolve to supplied complete page extracts. Final browser test opens/closes the native menu with keyboard, follows real links with pointer, asserts destination fragments/information and returns. No paper proxy is called actual screen navigation.
source_checks.availability: One existing synchronizer-generated availability-aware app entrance per page, correct year/subject/access/return metadata, no retired or duplicate CTA exposed. No app bank availability was changed or newly certified.
source_checks.cultural_evidence: Reopened QCAA, Reconciliation Australia, Magabala publisher and teacher notes. Welcome permission roles and anyone offering Acknowledgement are accurately separated. Nura/Country and yana/walk are attributed to the Darug source; actual lawful book/glossary and locally authorised greeting must be prepared before dependent learning. No cultural artwork, ceremony, local word, pronunciation or authority is invented.

per_code_risk_results.LA01: Context/familiarity/roles and real protocol permissions are explicit. Respectful wording is not used to infer age/status/authority; actual tone needs observation.
per_code_risk_results.LA02: Actual original text details support response reasons; different supported preferences accepted; liked/enjoyed/preferred not forced into a fixed strength scale. Country-specific appreciation uses an actual prepared source.
per_code_risk_results.LA03: Six complete original samples cover narrative/recount/report/procedure/opinion/poem response; common patterns not universal recipes, form not a purpose label.
per_code_risk_results.LA04: Personal and ownership references, recoverable omitted words and ambiguous references checked in complete supplied contexts. Left-facing visual reference arrow corrected.
per_code_risk_results.LA05: Chapter versus printed page and alphabetical index distinction correct; complete destination information present; actual menu/link actions tested with JavaScript disabled.
per_code_risk_results.LA06: Independent clauses, addition/contrast/choice/result and shared-subject contrast explained under a consistent primary convention. Open grammatical alternatives accepted when relationship is unstated.
per_code_risk_results.LA07: Complete noun/verb groups, helper/time/plural agreement and useful detail explained. State verbs allowed; a/an selected by next spoken sound.
per_code_risk_results.LA08: Actual kitten and three-panel duck pixels, authored speech/thought choices and real seed counts support the tasks. Observation, inference and invented meaning separated; table does not prove a cause.
per_code_risk_results.LA09: Word meaning must fit context; invented role/action model now explicitly marked as fiction. Darug attribution/local-use boundary remains accurate.
per_code_risk_results.LA10: Title-case versus sentence-case styles declared; complete list items and consistent optional serial comma accepted; exact earlier title target supplied.

render_checks.decision: PASS after bounded arrow repair. Labels and models are readable, relationships accurate, images complete at the inspected model size, aspect ratios preserved and captions consistent. Phone multi-panel art intentionally pans inside a focusable frame; this is not page overflow or missing image content.
render_checks.all_other_98_frames: Byte-identical to the browser2 artifact; all model pixels except the corrected arrow retain earlier individual inspections.
render_checks.browser_machine_results: Final 30 JavaScript-disabled visits at 1440/768/390 and 10 JavaScript-enabled smoke visits pass, including native answers, local responses/images, touch targets, stacking, phone keyboard panning and actual LA05 navigation. problems[] is empty.
render_checks.initial_failure_history: First browser run had three LA05 pointer click stability timeouts and lacked its six viewport captures. The test now scrolls the actual link instantly to the centre before a real pointer click, without removing assertions or changing page/CSS behavior. Second run passed; third confirmed the corrected arrow. Failed runs are not relabelled as passes.
